description.value: You can cast any spell as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.YSB1QtxZW2BI9f4Y#casting-without-slots]{Ritual} if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook.
